% A Pandoc template for a Physical Review Letters source submission.
% Title, authors, affiliations, emails, abstract, date and keywords are metadata, never template text.
\documentclass[aps,prl,reprint,superscriptaddress,amsmath,amssymb,floatfix]{revtex4-2}
\usepackage{booktabs}
\usepackage{calc}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{array}
\usepackage{longtable}
\usepackage{siunitx}
\providecommand{\pandocbounded}[1]{#1}
\setkeys{Gin}{width=\columnwidth,keepaspectratio}
$if(highlighting-macros)$
$highlighting-macros$
$endif$

\begin{document}

$if(title)$
\title{$title$}
$endif$

$for(author)$
\author{$author.name$}
$if(author.email)$
\email{$author.email$}
$endif$
$if(author.affiliation)$
\affiliation{$author.affiliation$}
$endif$
$endfor$

$if(date)$
\date{$date$}
$endif$

$if(abstract)$
\begin{abstract}
$abstract$
\end{abstract}
$endif$

$if(keywords)$
\keywords{$for(keywords)$$keywords$$sep$, $endfor$}
$endif$

$if(title)$
\maketitle
$endif$

$body$

\bibliographystyle{apsrev4-2}
\bibliography{references}
\end{document}
